title: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 2: Michezo)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child reads a dictionary entry for its spelling, word class, noun class and meaning.

floor.prerequisite: Finds a word by its root.
floor.question: Utatafuta neno lipi kwa "walicheza"?

representations: a list of short forms (nm, kt, kv)
steps: Read the word class and noun class.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child labels the entry and finds another word's ngeli.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Neno gani huja kwanza kwenye kamusi?" Kwa nini "mti" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kamusi hupanga maneno kwa herufi za alfabeti, si kwa urefu wa neno.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Neno gani huja kwanza kwenye kamusi?" Kwa nini "samaki" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maneno yanapoanza kwa herufi moja, tazama herufi ya pili, kisha ya tatu: sahani huja kabla ya samaki.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Neno gani huja mwisho kwenye kamusi?" Kwa nini "ndizi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Alfabeti huanza na A na kuishia na Z. Neno la mwisho kwenye kamusi huanza na herufi ya mwisho zaidi.
Kamusi huonyesha aina ya neno, ngeli na wingi pia.
